concept: A chip is a small glass pane you press. On, it is pressed into the glass, a carved recess with a check, so many chosen chips add no loud marks to the pane.

root.why: a small glass pane with gloss and the pane rim, something to press

on.why: chosen is pressed into the glass, a carved recess with a heavier weight

toggle.why: the chip itself is the button, with a 44px press area

remove.why: remove is its own named button with a 44px press area

removable.why: a removable chip is a label with one action at its end, so its body is not pressable

icon.why: the check marks a chosen chip and the cross marks remove, shapes as well as colour

focus-visible.why: keyboard focus draws the shared ring with its halo, visible on any scene

active.why: a press shrinks the chip slightly, faster than hover

@media forced-colors: active.why: forced colours drop the rim and the carve, so a real system-colour border keeps the shape

box-shadow.why: pressing in and out changes the carve at hover pace

background-color.why: the fill changes at the same pace as the carve

transform.why: the press runs at press pace, a reply to the reader

default_to_avoid.pattern: outlined filter chips that fill with the brand colour when chosen (Material filter chips)
default_to_avoid.why_not: every chosen chip becomes a loud filled mark, so a row of filters competes with the pane's one loud action

derivation.consequence: the loud action is a solid pill; everything else is a quiet pill or text
derivation.form: chips stay quiet pills in both states; chosen is never the loud solid

derivation.consequence: a pressed control shrinks slightly, as something pushed
derivation.form: chosen is pressed into the glass, a carved recess, as something pushed

derivation.consequence: selected and pressed states change shape or add a mark (a check, a ring), never only colour
derivation.form: chosen adds a check and a heavier weight

derivation.consequence: a soft shadow below and a rim of light on the top-left edge say where the pane floats
derivation.form: off is a small pane with the pane rim, so it reads as something to press

derivation.consequence: every target is at least 44px in its smaller dimension or has a 44px hit area
derivation.form: a 32px chip keeps a 44px hit area

variants.reason: A and B make each chosen chip the loud solid, so three chosen filters put three loud marks on a pane (P5). C keeps chips quiet: off is a small pane to press, on is pressed into a carved recess with a check (P4, P6). The first C, rings, was too faint and was replaced in the lab before the pick.
